description.en: Hunter Biden’s Laptop (LAPTOP) is a memecoin referencing the eponymous Hunter Biden laptop sensation that’s been a fixture in global media news cycles for the past six years. LAPTOP is a fungible, freely transferable, non-yield-bearing ERC-20 token on Base. As a memecoin, LAPTOP has no utility, but incorporates two novel distribution mechanics designed to promote long-term community growth: a large community airdrop and an event-based supply mechanism.
